title: rubus histrix var. macrodontus
intro: Rubus histrix var. macrodontus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan raspberry root, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rubus histrix var. macrodontus include acting as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic, as well as having a protective effect on the stomach and intestines. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
